name: Tank front (est.): Leopard 2A6 turret
description: Forum estimates around 800-850 mm vs long rods (the often-quoted 1300 mm is probably vs shaped charges). Stand-in: a block of armour steel as thick as the estimated protection against long rods (RHA equivalent, line of sight). Real tank armour is secret composite; public estimates vary widely between sources - this is a rough guide, not data.
